ποιῶσι, triremes ex cedro faciunt. Iofeph. εἰσεκόμισε τὴν χρυσῆν σκεύην, λυχνίαν,
σπάπεζαν, βωμὸν, ἐκ χρυσοῦ πεποιημένα, importavit & nova vafa, candelabrum,
Dativus hîc etiam aliquando eft. Demofth. ὃ τῷ μὴ καλυφθῆναι ταῦτα
σεμνυόμεγ[?], ἀλλὰ τῷ γραφεὶς ἀποφυγεῖν, nō eo glorior quód hæc non prodide-
rim, neq; eo quód accufationem ef-
fugerim. Talis illa rectio eft Latinis,

page.notes: Small marks at the lower left margin (a faint dash and stroke) are stains, not text. Greek passages from Herodotus, Theophrastus and Josephus are transcribed from a faint scan; the Demosthenes line and the hyphenated Greek word in the Herodotus line are doubtful and marked [?].
